credit: Quaternius (original character); UMRAM, Bilkent University (prepared static pose). Sahara coordinate adaptation.
adaptation: Baked rigid rotation (x,y,z) -> (-z,y,x) into position and normal buffers. Updated position accessor bounds. No shape, topology or material change. No node transforms.

coordinates.pointNormalization: Use inverse scene transform, then x/height, (y-minY)/height, z/height. Store stable body-local xyz and explicit side/region labels; never screen-left as patient-left.

limitations: Stylised adult mannequin, not patient-specific anatomy or validated medical measurement.
Single mesh has no anatomical semantic labels, organ structures or segment IDs. Region classification is an interface heuristic and needs patient correction.
Changing red intensity must reflect the entered severity; no severity should be inferred from the selected position.
Upstream README orientation was contradicted by independent four-view vertex render. Delivered coordinates are independently corrected.

rightsEvidence.basis: Pinned prepared mesh was publicly released under CC0 in June 2026 with explicit Quaternius source attribution. Current creator FAQ and specific base-character page also state CC0. Current general QAL page changed August 2026 and says future changes are not retroactive; do not generalize this asset license to other current Quaternius downloads. Exact original character pack is not identified by the upstream repository.
